# bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/pdb2gmx

## Summary

Wrapper class for the GROMACS pdb2gmx module.

The GROMACS pdb2gmx module, reads a .pdb (or .gro) file, reads some database files, adds hydrogens to the molecules and generates coordinates in GROMACS (GROMOS), or optionally .pdb, format and a topology in GROMACS format. These files can subsequently be processed to generate a run input file.

Nextflow adapter of the [Pdb2gmx](https://biobb-gromacs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gromacs.html#module-gromacs.pdb2gmx) building block of [biobb_gromacs](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_gromacs) 5.3.2.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_GROMACS_PDB2GMX } from 'bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/pdb2gmx'

workflow {
    BIOBB_GROMACS_PDB2GMX(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the input PDB file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_gro_path` | yes | gro | Path to the output GRO file |
| `output_top_zip_path` | yes | zip | Path the output TOP topology in zip format |
| `versions_biobb_gromacs` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_gromacs', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Pdb2gmx properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_gro_path: 'gro']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_gromacs container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_GROMACS_PDB2GMX' {
        ext.properties = [water_type: 'spc']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `water_type` | string | "spce" | Water molecule type. Values: spc, spce, tip3p, tip4p, tip5p, tips3p. |
| `force_field` | string | "amber99sb-ildn" | Force field to be used during the conversion. Values: gromos45a3, charmm27, gromos53a6, amber96, amber99, gromos43a2, gromos54a7, gromos43a1, amberGS, gromos53a5, amber99sb, amber03, amber99sb-ildn, oplsaa, amber94, amber99sb-star-ildn-mut. |
| `ignh` | boolean | false | Should pdb2gmx ignore the hydrogens in the original structure. |
| `lys` | array | null | Lysine protonation states for each chain in the input pdb. Each item of the list should be a string with the protonation states for that chain or empty if the residue is not present in that chain (0: not protonated, 1: protonated). |
| `arg` | array | null | Arginine protonation states for each chain in the input pdb. Each item of the list should be a string with the protonation states for that chain or empty if the residue is not present in that chain (0: not protonated, 1: protonated). |
| `asp` | array | null | Aspartic acid protonation states for each chain in the input pdb. Each item of the list should be a string with the protonation states for that chain or empty if the residue is not present in that chain (0: not protonated, 1: protonated). |
| `glu` | array | null | Glutamic acid protonation states for each chain in the input pdb. Each item of the list should be a string with the protonation states for that chain or empty if the residue is not present in that chain (0: not protonated, 1: protonated). |
| `gln` | array | null | Glutamine protonation states for each chain in the input pdb. Each item of the list should be a string with the protonation states for that chain or empty if the residue is not present in that chain (0: not protonated, 1: protonated). |
| `his` | array | null | Histidine protonation states for each chain in the input pdb. Each item of the list should be a string with the protonation states for that chain or empty if the residue is not present in that chain. Make sure residues are named HIS (0: HID, 1: HIE, 2: HIP, 3: HIS1). |
| `merge` | boolean | false | Merge all chains into a single molecule. |
| `gmx_lib` | string | null | Path set GROMACS GMXLIB environment variable. |
| `binary_path` | string | "gmx" | Path to the GROMACS executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
